test_MessageToJson_proto3: test converting a proto3 message to JSON string using json_format.MessageToJson with all field types
test_Parse_json_to_message: test parsing a JSON string into a protobuf message using json_format.Parse and verifying field values
test_MessageToDict_and_ParseDict: test converting a protobuf message to a Python dict with MessageToDict and back with ParseDict
test_json_format_well_known_types: test serializing and parsing well-known types like Timestamp, Duration, Any, and FieldMask via JSON format
test_json_format_extension_fields: test serializing protobuf extension fields to JSON using bracket notation and parsing them back
